text: {"lessons":["Buying 500 shares of Stock C after its price fell sharply concentrated my risk; I should size positions deliberately rather than treat a lower price as evidence of a bargain.","Selling some winners and later selling Stock C at a gain worked out this time, but gains alone do not tell me what prices will do next; I should base trades on a consistent plan, not recent performance.","I should review the whole portfolio’s allocation and risk regularly, and compare each possible trade with holding cash or the other stocks instead of trading just to feel active."]}
